source_note: Existence index built from the public EOIR Agency Decisions pages at https://www.justice.gov/eoir/ag-bia-decisions. Volumes 8-26 come from the interim decision lists (/eoir/vll/intdec/nfvolNN.html). Volumes 27-30 come from /eoir/volume-N. Volume 30 is also unioned with this site's BIA library, which is built from the same pages. Each entry is a volume, page, case name, and official link. A listed citation exists. Nothing here says the decision is still good law or that it supports a claim.
gaps: Volumes 1-7 are not published as HTML decision lists on the Agency Decisions index (they are in cumulative-index PDFs) and are not covered.
OCAHO decision lists on the same index page are a different reporter and are not included.
